decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and control the game. By combining efficient black creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Nantuko Shade with powerful disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Duress, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with creatures. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Phyrexian Arena and Graveborn Muse to maintain a steady stream of resources. Wasteland and Cursed Scroll provide additional utility and versatility to deal with problematic cards or situations.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Ill-Gotten Gains combo, utilizing cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, Cabal Ritual, and Dark Ritual to generate mana and access to card draw and recursion spells such as Opt, Cunning Wish, and Intuition. Orim's Chant provides protection while Brain Freeze acts as a win condition. The deck aims to efficiently search for and accumulate resources to overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan by recycling key cards with Ill-Gotten Gains.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana production using Elves and Gaea's Cradle, while using creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent and maintain board control. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and powerful spells, while also utilizing Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures. The inclusion of cards like Tangle Wire and Rishadan Port adds additional disruption and control elements to the deck, allowing it to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with strong mana dorks like Fyndhorn Elves and Llanowar Elves, generating large amounts of mana with cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle. The key strategy is to play creatures rapidly, utilize powerful abilities like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote to maintain tempo, and finish off opponents with overwhelming creature presence or a game-ending Biorhythm. The deck also includes control elements like Deranged Hermit and Masticore to handle threats, while creating opportunities to make explosive plays with cards like Survival of the Fittest and Crop Rotation.

This premodern 1 vs 1 combo Enchantress deck aims to utilize enchantresses to draw cards, accelerate mana with enchantments like Wild Growth and Exploration, and eventually win with Opalescence turning enchantments into creatures. The deck includes control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing to handle threats, while also having utility with cards like Sterling Grove and Parallax Wave. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with card advantage, mana acceleration, and the ability to turn enchantments into threats, ultimately overwhelming the opponent and securing victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing counter spells and removal to control the board while also stalling the game with land destruction and card draw. It aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and eventually win with its own win conditions like Decree of Justice or Mishra's Factory. The deck is built around disrupting the opponent's strategies and generating card advantage, forcing them to play on its terms. It is a patient and methodical deck that thrives on outlasting and outmaneuvering its opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and lock pieces like Standstill and Humility. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own resources through card advantage and efficient mana usage. By creating a resource advantage and limiting the opponent's options, the deck can eventually overpower the opponent with powerful finishers like Decree of Justice or Mishra's Factory. The deck focuses on controlling the board and grinding out victory through attrition.

The main idea of this deck is to efficiently stall the game with removal spells and disruption while setting up for a game-winning combo with Replenish. By using cards like Attunement and Intuition to fill the graveyard with enchantments, the player can then cast Replenish to bring back a board full of powerful enchantments like Opalescence, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave. This can lead to overwhelming the opponent and securing victory. The deck also includes cards like Tsabo's Web and Seal of Cleansing to control the board and protect the combo pieces.

The Mono Blue Control deck focuses on utilizing counterspells, card draw, and land manipulation to control the game and limit opponents' options. By using cards like Counterspell, Mana Leak, and Stifle to disrupt opponents' strategies, along with card advantage from Accumulated Knowledge and Fact or Fiction, the deck aims to outlast opponents and win the game through attrition. Parallax Tide also provides a versatile removal option, while Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave offer additional threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and out-maneuver opponents to achieve victory.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with various elf creatures and Gaea's Cradle while utilizing the ability to search for and play key creatures with Survival of the Fittest. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a high creature count and powerful abilities, facilitating aggressive gameplay and quick victories. The deck includes cards like Wirewood Symbiote for protection and recursion, and cards like Deranged Hermit and Multani's Acolyte for additional value and board presence. The deck aims to establish dominance early in the game and maintain pressure throughout.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board while using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore. The strategy involves using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Cataclysm to disrupt the opponent's plans, while also utilizing Call of the Herd and Sylvan Library for card advantage. By managing the board and resources effectively, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells. Additionally, the deck includes lands like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to further disrupt the opponent's mana base and strategy.

The deck is focused on the aggressive red mana archetype, utilizing low-cost and efficient creatures like Goblin Patrol, Grim Lavamancer, and Jackal Pup to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes burn spells like Incinerate, Lightning Bolt, and Fireblast to deal direct damage and close out the game. Cursed Scroll and Reckless Abandon provide additional ways to push damage through. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with consistent damage output and finishes with cards like Barbarian Ring to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to create a lock on the opponent through the use of Stasis, preventing them from untapping their permanents. This allows the player to control the pace of the game and eventually win through a combo finish with cards like Brain Freeze or Upheaval. The deck is built around protecting Stasis with counterspells and bouncing spells, while also utilizing cards like Black Vise and Forsaken City to pressure the opponent's life total. Overall, the goal is to stall the game until the combo pieces can be assembled for a win.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards like Phyrexian Dreadnought, Stifle, and Vision Charm to pull off a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm and defeat the opponent. By using counterspells and card draw to control the game, the deck aims to set up the ideal conditions for the combo to be executed successfully. With a strong emphasis on disruption and efficiency, this deck is geared towards achieving a game-winning play as quickly and reliably as possible.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly and efficiently assemble the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo by using cards like Stifle and Vision Charm to cheat it into play. The deck also includes a suite of powerful counter spells and card draw effects to protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. Mishra's Factory provides additional creature threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the game early on while setting up for a game-winning combo finish.

The concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruption, while also maintaining card advantage with card draw effects like Accumulated Knowledge and Sylvan Library. The deck also includes threats like Psychatog and Exalted Angel to pressure the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck while also providing consistent access to different colors of mana. Overall, the goal is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until the control player can secure a win.
